text:
alice: quick heads up — planning a config-only rollout at 02:15 UTC. targets: prod global, staged. changes: max_worker_concurrency 80 -> 56, default_tenant_rate 140 -> 100, batch_target 14 -> 10, request_timeout_ms 11000 -> 8500. pin routing policy to 'latency-first' for rollout window. canary in us-west2 for 18m.

bob: copy. what's the rollback gate?

alice: rollback if p99 increases >25% OR 5xx >0.4% sustained 10m, or if kvcache evictions/sec >150 on any host.

chris: I'll add synthetic probes hitting top routes and a quick dashboard: p95/p99, evicts, inflight, per-tenant throttles.

deploy-bot: [scheduled] config-only rollout cfg-2026-05-04-003 -> canary(us-west2) at 1758765600

ops-laura: recommend ttl_warm_ms=9000 on canary for 5m to reduce kvcache churn. Also prepare per-tenant override playbook.

bob: preflight: redwoodctl config diff --env prod --key batch_target; redwoodctl apply --scope canary --file canary-pulse.json

deploy-bot: [canary applied] cfg-2026-05-04-003 at 1758765650

chris: 10m snapshot: p95 200ms (base 185ms), p99 760ms (base 720ms), 5xx 0.01%. no alerts.

alice: plan slow ramp: 4% -> 15% -> 45% -> 100% with manual sign-off at each gate. ops please hold manual gates.

deploy-bot: [rollout] -> 4% at 1758765780

chris: alert: spike in evictions in eu-central tied to tenant-R at 1758765845, p99 on those hosts up to 1.5s.

alice: pause ramp. ops-laura hold further increases.

ops-laura: paused. initiating targeted rollback on eu-central route weight.

bob: tenant-R uses long sequences; smaller batches likely increased kv churn. suggest per-tenant override: tenant-R.batch_target=14 and tenant-R.rate=180.

deploy-bot: [hotfix apply] per-tenant override for tenant-R at 1758765900

chris: post-hotfix: eu-central p99 down to 740ms, 5xx normal.

alice: decision: no global rollback. keep global config but add per-tenant exceptions for long-sequence tenants. Update runbook to list per-tenant override as first recovery knob.

ops-laura: resume plan: continue from 4% -> 15% after 12m hold, manual checks at each stage.

alice: tagging release cfg-2026-05-04-003. I will post release notes after 100% and 30m healthy.

bob: release notes snippet: "Config-only tuning: reduced worker concurrency and batch target to tighten latency variance. Per-tenant exceptions applied for long-sequence workloads to avoid kv churn."

chris: monitoring shows stable at 4% for 9m. ready for next gate when ops gives the nod.

ops-laura: giving nod to proceed to 15% in 10m if no new alerts.

alice: thanks team — will follow up with a short post-rollout summary."
